Create a Google Service Account and request an increase in the Requests Per Minute (RPM) quota from Google.
Add logic to classify devices into High, Medium, and Low confidence levels based on the Verified Access response and validation checks.

Validate that existing SRE Broker APIs continue to function correctly after the Verified Access integration.\
